name: effect-parry-timing-ring
title: Parry Window
description: Một vòng tròn co dần quanh khiên, đúng lúc vòng chạm vạch đích thì đỡ: loé vòng sáng, khiên giật nhẹ, hạt nổ, viên đạn bị bật ngược lên và chữ "PARRY" bật ra.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-game-combat-parry-window, written here): px @320x200. Timing ring (stroke 2, accent) shrinks radius 54 → 16 linearly over 700 ms (0.3-1.0 s), opacity 0.3 → 1, onto a dashed target circle r 16. Contact at 1.0 s: flash ring 16 → 40 (stroke 3) in 350 ms outCubic; shield pushed 6 px (250 ms half-sine); 9-dot burst to 20 px (300 ms). The projectile comes in at ~269 px/s and leaves up-right at 420 px/s x, 90 px/s up (~1.6×; site label says ×2.4) for 600 ms; 'PARRY' pops 300 ms back.out. Params: from / to: bán kính vòng (54 → 16 px) · window: thời gian co (0.7 s) · hitAt: lúc chạm (1.0 s) · push: khiên giật (6 px). The projectile comes in at 269 px/s and is sent back at 420 px/s, 90 px/s up (the site's label says × 2.4; its numbers give about × 1.6).
